name: App promo
description: For a phone app only: a vertical promo with the app on a phone. A hook over footage, the app's name over its own screen recording, three of its screens (today's plan, a question answered, a helper citing its source), a bigger session, the two goals to reach, the result, the list of what the app covers, and the end card. Five footage slots; one takes the app's own recording. 38 s, also cut to 15 s (the hook, today's plan, the end card) and 30 s (without the list). Pick it only for a brief about an app; for any other business, pick a photo card or the Data story. Its music is "Spring of 2026" by Sascha Ende (CC BY 4.0) from 47.9 s; the post's copy carries its credit.

hook_line.label: Hook: the headline
hook_line.description: The video's first words, large over the hook footage, landing word by word as the voice says them. The accent words follow it. Four or five words.

hook_accent.label: Hook: the accent words
hook_accent.description: One or two words that end the headline, in the brand colour, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

hook_question.label: Hook: the question
hook_question.description: A short question under the headline, in the brand colour, spoken next. It sets up what the app answers.

app_name.label: The app's name
app_name.description: Small above the slogan in the reveal, over the app's own loop, and large on the end card. Write it exactly as the app is called.

slogan_line_1.label: Reveal: the slogan's first line
slogan_line_1.description: Very large in the reveal, under the app's name; write it in capitals. One or two words; the accent word and the second line follow under it.

slogan_accent.label: Reveal: the slogan's accent word
slogan_accent.description: One short word in the brand colour that starts the slogan's second line, very large; write it in capitals.

slogan_line_2.label: Reveal: the slogan's second line
slogan_line_2.description: The rest of the slogan's second line, after the accent word, very large; write it in capitals. One word.

slogan_note.label: Reveal: the line under the slogan
slogan_note.description: Small text under the slogan in the reveal: what the app is, in a few words. Leave empty for none.

phone_time.label: Phone: the clock
phone_time.description: The time in the top bar of the phone's first screen. Any time works: it is only the phone's clock.

phone_time_later.label: Help screen: the clock
phone_time_later.description: The time in the top bar of the phone's second screen, the help screen: a minute after the first screen's clock.

course_code.label: Phone: the badge at the top
course_code.description: A short tag in the header of the phone's first screen: what the person is working on in the app, as a short name or code.

today_label.label: Phone: the progress card's label
today_label.description: Small capitals on the progress card, the first card on the phone's first screen, above the card's line.

today_detail.label: Phone: the progress card's line
today_detail.description: One line on the progress card, beside the ring: what is on today in the app, its items separated by ' · '.

today_percent.label: Phone: today's progress, in percent
today_percent.description: A whole number from 0 to 100. The ring on the progress card fills to it and shows it as a figure.

streak.label: Phone: the number by the flame
streak.description: A small number beside a flame on the progress card, such as days in a row. Digits only.

question_topic.label: Phone: the question's topic
question_topic.description: A small chip at the top of the question card, under the progress card: the subject the question comes from.

question_label.label: Phone: the question card's label
question_label.description: Small capitals above the question, telling the viewer what to do.

question_text.label: Phone: the question
question_text.description: The question on the card, in one or two sentences. Answers A to D follow under it, and A is the one picked.

option_a.label: Phone: answer A, the right one
option_a.description: The first answer under the question. It is tapped and marked with a tick, so it must be the right answer.

option_b.label: Phone: answer B
option_b.description: The second answer under the question, a wrong one. It fades when answer A is picked.

option_c.label: Phone: answer C
option_c.description: The third answer under the question, a wrong one. It fades when answer A is picked.

option_d.label: Phone: answer D
option_d.description: The fourth answer under the question, a wrong one. It fades when answer A is picked.

result_label.label: Phone: the word after the pick
result_label.description: Shown in bold under the answers once answer A is picked, beside the help button.

tutor_button.label: Phone: the help button
tutor_button.description: A button beside the word after the pick. The help screen follows it.

source_note.label: Phone: the note about the source
source_note.description: Small text at the foot of the question card: where the question comes from or how it was checked. It describes the app, so keep it true.

source_link.label: Phone: the source link
source_link.description: A link at the foot of the question card, beside the note about the source, ending in ' ↗'.

tutor_header.label: Help screen: the header
tutor_header.description: The small title at the top of the phone's second screen, the help screen, which follows the question card.

tutor_title.label: Help screen: the title
tutor_title.description: The large title under the header on the help screen.

tutor_about.label: Help screen: what it is about
tutor_about.description: One line under the help screen's title: what the help is about, such as the question just answered.

tutor_question.label: Help screen: the question asked
tutor_question.description: The person's question on the help screen, shown as their message. One short sentence.

tutor_answer.label: Help screen: the answer
tutor_answer.description: The app's reply under the person's question, typing itself out word by word. Two or three short sentences.

cite_ok.label: Help screen: the source chip
cite_ok.description: A small chip under the answer saying the answer has a source, starting with '✓ '. It describes the app, so keep it true.

cite_link.label: Help screen: the link chip
cite_link.description: A second chip beside the source chip: a link to check the answer, ending in ' ↗'.

tutor_scope.label: Help screen: the note under the answer
tutor_scope.description: Small text under the chips on the help screen: what the help covers. Leave empty for none.

ask_placeholder.label: Help screen: the message box's hint
ask_placeholder.description: The hint in the empty message box at the foot of the help screen.

ask_speak.label: Help screen: the speak button
ask_speak.description: The button beside the message box for asking by voice.

ask_send.label: Help screen: the send button
ask_send.description: The button at the end of the message box that sends the message.

dock_1.label: Phone: menu tab 1
dock_1.description: The first tab in the menu bar at the foot of the phone, shown as the open one. The bar stays on both phone screens.

dock_2.label: Phone: menu tab 2
dock_2.description: The second tab in the menu bar at the foot of the phone.

dock_3.label: Phone: menu tab 3
dock_3.description: The third tab in the menu bar at the foot of the phone.

dock_4.label: Phone: menu tab 4
dock_4.description: The fourth tab in the menu bar at the foot of the phone.

mock_title.label: Big moment: the title
mock_title.description: Large title on a card of its own after the phone: the app's biggest step, such as a full session. A few words.

mock_detail.label: Big moment: the detail
mock_detail.description: One line under the big moment's title: what the step involves, such as how long it takes.

mock_button.label: Big moment: the button
mock_button.description: The button on the big moment's card, pressed with a ripple before the goals show. A word or two that begins the step.

gate_title.label: Goals: the title
gate_title.description: Small capitals over the two goals, on the card that follows the big moment: what the person must reach.

gate_1.label: Goals: goal 1
gate_1.description: The first goal on the goals card, ticked off. Any figure in it is a fact about the app, so keep it true.

gate_2.label: Goals: goal 2
gate_2.description: The second goal on the goals card, ticked off just after the first. Any figure in it is a fact about the app, so keep it true.

grade_note.label: Result: the line above
grade_note.description: Small capitals above the big result, on its own screen after the goals: what the result means.

grade.label: Result: the big result
grade.description: Very large, on its own screen after the goals: up to three characters, such as a letter or a mark. The lines above and below frame it.

grade_caveat.label: Result: the line below
grade_caveat.description: A short line in large type under the big result: a twist or a condition on it.

tracks_title.label: List: the title
tracks_title.description: The heading over the list of what the app covers, a grid of ten items. A few words.

tracks_detail.label: List: the line under the title
tracks_detail.description: One line under the list's heading, such as how much the app holds. Each figure in it is a fact that needs its source.

track_1_code.label: List: item 1's short code
track_1_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 1, above its name.

track_1_name.label: List: item 1's name
track_1_name.description: The name of list item 1, under its code. It lights up as the voice says the spoken word for item 1.

track_2_code.label: List: item 2's short code
track_2_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 2, above its name.

track_2_name.label: List: item 2's name
track_2_name.description: The name of list item 2, under its code. It lights up as the voice says the spoken word for item 2.

track_3_code.label: List: item 3's short code
track_3_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 3, above its name.

track_3_name.label: List: item 3's name
track_3_name.description: The name of list item 3, under its code, in the grid of ten.

track_4_code.label: List: item 4's short code
track_4_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 4, above its name.

track_4_name.label: List: item 4's name
track_4_name.description: The name of list item 4, under its code. It lights up as the voice says the spoken word for item 4.

track_5_code.label: List: item 5's short code
track_5_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 5, above its name.

track_5_name.label: List: item 5's name
track_5_name.description: The name of list item 5, under its code. It lights up as the voice says the spoken word for item 5.

track_6_code.label: List: item 6's short code
track_6_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 6, above its name.

track_6_name.label: List: item 6's name
track_6_name.description: The name of list item 6, under its code, in the grid of ten.

track_7_code.label: List: item 7's short code
track_7_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 7, above its name.

track_7_name.label: List: item 7's name
track_7_name.description: The name of list item 7, under its code, in the grid of ten.

track_8_code.label: List: item 8's short code
track_8_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 8, above its name.

track_8_name.label: List: item 8's name
track_8_name.description: The name of list item 8, under its code, in the grid of ten.

track_9_code.label: List: item 9's short code
track_9_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 9, above its name.

track_9_name.label: List: item 9's name
track_9_name.description: The name of list item 9, under its code, in the grid of ten.

track_10_code.label: List: item 10's short code
track_10_code.description: A short code or abbreviation on list item 10, above its name.

track_10_name.label: List: item 10's name
track_10_name.description: The name of list item 10, under its code, the last in the grid of ten.

end_line.label: End card: the line under the name
end_line.description: On the end card, under the logo and the app's name, over the end card footage. A few words.

end_accent.label: End card: the closing words
end_accent.description: Large closing words in the brand colour, under the line on the end card. Two or three words.

end_url.label: End card: the web address
end_url.description: The web address at the foot of the end card, written without https://.

end_note.label: End card: the small print
end_note.description: Small print under the web address, such as a note the copy rules require. Leave empty for none.

cap_practice.label: Phone: the voice line
cap_practice.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption while the phone's first screen plays. One short sentence, about ten words.

cap_tutor.label: Help screen: the voice line
cap_tutor.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption while the help screen plays. One short sentence, about ten words.

cap_mock.label: Big moment: the voice line
cap_mock.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption over the big moment and the goals. One short sentence, about ten words.

beat_1.label: List: the first spoken words
beat_1.description: Said as the list appears and shown first in the caption under it: two or three words that sum up the list.

beat_2.label: List: the spoken word for item 1
beat_2.description: Said next and shown in the caption under the list; list item 1 lights up as it is said. A word or two naming item 1.

beat_3.label: List: the spoken word for item 2
beat_3.description: Said next and shown in the caption under the list; list item 2 lights up as it is said. A word or two naming item 2.

beat_4.label: List: the spoken word for item 4
beat_4.description: Said next and shown in the caption under the list; list item 4 lights up as it is said. A word or two naming item 4.

beat_5.label: List: the spoken word for item 5
beat_5.description: Said last and shown in the caption under the list; list item 5 lights up as it is said. A word or two naming item 5.

reveal_voice.label: Reveal: the voice line
reveal_voice.description: Said by the voice as the app is revealed, and not shown on screen: usually the app's name, then its slogan.

grade_voice.label: Result: the voice line
grade_voice.description: Said by the voice as the big result appears, and not shown on screen. Write the result as it is said, in words, not symbols.

end_voice.label: End card: the voice line
end_voice.description: Said by the voice over the end card, and not shown on screen: usually the app's name and the closing words.

hook.label: Hook footage
hook.description: 9:16, 4-5 s, no readable text or logos: a person with a phone on the move, e.g. a commute. Plays 0-4.95 s under the hook and holds its last frame.

app_loop.label: The app's own loop
app_loop.description: 9:16, about 4 s: the app's real animation or screen recording (never generated UI). Plays 4.95-8.85 s behind the slogan.

desk.label: Desk footage
desk.description: 9:16, 4 s, no readable text or logos: someone studying at a desk. Plays 8.85-12.9 s behind the phone.

focus.label: Focus footage
focus.description: 9:16, 4 s, no readable text or logos: a moment of concentration. Plays 17.1-21.1 s behind the mock exam.

end.label: End card footage
end.description: 9:16, 5 s, no readable text or logos: an open, hopeful shot, e.g. a rooftop at dusk. Plays 29.5-38 s behind the end card and holds its last frame.

sample_data.question_text: A product team can fully describe a 3-step pipeline (fetch → transform → notify) with known branching. Which architecture best fits?
sample_data.option_a: A code-orchestrated workflow with tool use
sample_data.option_b: An open-ended agent that decides the steps
sample_data.option_d: A single LLM call with no tools
sample_data.tutor_question: Why a workflow — not an agent?
sample_data.tutor_answer: Because every step is known up front — fetch, transform, notify. A code-orchestrated workflow with tool use is predictable and testable. Reach for an agent when the steps can't be known in advance.
sample_data.tutor_scope: Exam-domain answers only — not general chat.
sample_data.gate_title: The gate — both parts must be green
sample_data.gate_2: One full mock at 720/1000 or better
sample_data.grade_note: Passed with margin — the A+ standard
sample_data.end_note: Independent exam prep. Not affiliated with Anthropic, GitHub, Google Cloud or IAPP.
sample_data.cap_practice: Ten minutes a day. Questions, labs and real scenarios.
sample_data.cap_tutor: Stuck? Ask the tutor. Every answer cites its source.
sample_data.cap_mock: Then sit the full mock. Real clock. Real standard.
sample_data.reveal_voice: Meet your app. Train your AI mind.
sample_data.end_voice: Your app. Free. Learn by doing. Prove it.
